ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It sets who fixes, how the re-review runs, and the attempt count.
ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md` to confirm line 12 says `--dry_run` and to check for other `--dry_run` uses before I edit.
ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md` line 12 to change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`.
ACTION: Commit the `docs/sync.md` change with a one-line message that says the docs now use the right flag name.
ACTION: Append a note to the implementer's report file in `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/`. The note says I changed `docs/sync.md:12` from `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`, that this is wording only, and that it changes no behavior, so no test covers it.
ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package` on the plan file with BASE set to the Task 3 head commit and HEAD set to the fix commit. This writes the diff file for the re-review.
ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review on `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The prompt names F1 verbatim, the diff file path, and the plan's global constraints. Its purpose is to confirm F1 is ADDRESSED and that there are no new Critical or Important findings.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- F1 changes only prose in `docs/sync.md`. No code or test reads that file. The skill allows the controller to fix a one-file, no-behavior change itself.
- The re-review still runs. The reviewer, not the author of the fix, confirms the finding is closed.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

I fixed F1, the reviewer's Important finding that `docs/sync.md:12` names the flag `--dry_run`. The line now says `--dry-run`, which matches the code, the help text and the tests. I committed the change. It is wording only, so no test covers it. I dispatched a scoped re-review. Task 3 stays open in the ledger until that review comes back clean.
